about: V8 music: the founder-supplied Eleven Music track, placed at 0.000 s under the founder's measured voice, mixed with keyframed volume curves. Generated by scripts/build-v8-audio.py.

file.source: ~/Downloads/ElevenLabs_NavisLabs_Platform_Introduction.mp3 (founder-supplied Eleven Music track, 127.84 s, 44.1 kHz MP3) → scripts/prepare-music-v8.py → 48 kHz WAV
file.processing: −1.5 dB headroom (source peaks +0.4 dBTP), 44.1 → 48 kHz, −2.5 dB presence carve at 3 kHz (Q 1.0) for dialogue intelligibility, trimmed to the film's length with a 0.8 s fade; no time-stretch, no pitch change
file.status: FINAL CANDIDATE — VERIFIED IN PROVIDED ASSET (founder-supplied ElevenLabs export). Licensing: NOT VERIFIED (depends on the ElevenLabs plan the track was generated on; free-tier tracks require crediting ElevenMusic).

sync_to_film: Act 1 held ~−7 dB (curve) so the opening problem sits over near-silence; the level opens on 'Navis' (14.03 s); the track's own rhythmic entrance follows at 18.6 s, 0.8 s before the S04 wipe.
The percussion texture starts at 53.3 s — 0.35 s after the cut to Navis Developer (52.95 s).
The track drops at 118.7 s — 'NavisLabs.' is at 118.8 s; the curve takes it to near-silence after the word and leaves a restrained tail under the tagline.

dips.why: act 1: almost silence under the opening problem — the supplied track is fuller here; the music opens on 'Navis'
the breath before Navis (the reverse swell rides through it)
'A person decides.' — the music drops back to a controlled breath, not silence

fallback.what: the V7 six-stem in-project score (public/music/temp/v7/*.wav) plays automatically if the final file is missing

replacement_plan_if_regenerated.tool: Eleven Music v2.5 (model_id music_v2_5) via scripts/elevenlabs-generate.py --music (composition plan in 'chunks'; section durations are enforced in v2/v2.5)

chunks.brief: almost no music, never dead: a low atmosphere under the contradiction; scattered high fragments as the systems appear; heavier on 'by hand'; held on 'without it'; a breath, then a reverse swell into 'Navis'
the first wow: on 'Navis' the music opens — warm harmonic bloom, deep pulse, small digital texture; the pipeline builds layer by layer and pulls back on 'next'
the Navis App: warm, intelligent, half-time; drops back to a controlled breath on 'A person decides.', returns on 'Then the company acts.'
Navis Developer: precise 16th-note rhythm, soft kick, analog bass; thins under the key lines; slows for the permission check with a low tonal shift on DENIED; resolves slightly as the run completes
solo → team → company: from one voice to the full ensemble; the voice alone carries 'Same facts. Same sources. Same freshness.'; lift on 'One understanding.', resolution on 'Two ways in.'
slow, deep, warm, wide; no rhythm; rises in the pause after 'Tools change.'; no crescendo
everything almost stops for 'NavisLabs.'; logo in near-silence; a very soft harmonic tail under the tagline; then silence

global_styles: clear memorable motif introduced at the reveal
replacement_plan_if_regenerated.after_generation: drop the export into ~/Downloads and run scripts/prepare-music-v8.py <file>; check the account plan allows commercial use (credit ElevenMusic on the free tier)
